_meta.what: Hand-compiled Odisha ecosystem layers analogous to jharkhand-landscape's indicative/funder/government tables. Every row traces to a public source. NOT independently field-verified; treat as leads. District names use model.json canon spelling.
_meta.confidence_legend: high = enumerated on the org's own site/report; med = count/partial or third-party; low = single directory/search-synthesis

anchors._note: TRI-equivalent multi-district anchor orgs. Jharkhand paints districts by TRI presence; Odisha has no TRI, so CYSD's named field-office districts are used as the concrete anchor-presence set. Gram Vikas / Harsha Trust / Niyatee are large multi-district anchors whose per-district lists aren't cleanly enumerated publicly, so they're listed as anchors without per-district paint.

vision2036._note: Odisha Vision 2036 (state centenary) + 2047 horizon, unveiled by the PM on 12 Jun 2025 (BJP govt first anniversary) alongside 105 projects worth ~₹18,600 Cr. Odisha is the first state to use an AI-assisted, 3.2-lakh-citizen-suggestion vision process. 36 flagship 'Developed Odisha by 2036' programmes across 36 areas. Figures from govt announcements & press; treat as stated targets, not audited outcomes.
